coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 1700 Owens Street
record.summary: A five-story commercial/research building at 1700 Owens Street in Mission Bay South. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8709, lot 007) records the building's construction year as 2007. UCSF's CFAR website has an event-location page for this address, but the page lists no events. No source read names its current occupants.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8709007 (3,991 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8709007)); 99% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 83% of the lot.

open_questions: Developer and architect not confirmed by any source found as of 2026-09-29.
The date any specific tenant first moved in is not confirmed by any source found -- only the Assessor's bare 2007 construction year is sourced.

Whether the UCSF-Bay Area Center for AIDS Research is based at 1700 Owens is not confirmed: the cited CFAR page is an event-location page that, when read on 2026-10-12, lists no events. A Gladstone page once cited for the Taube-Koret Center for Huntington's Disease Research being in this building is no longer available, so that claim was removed.

record.notes: Construction: DBI permit 200412282235 completed 2007-10-02 and Assessor year built 2007 (roll years 2009-2021); architect not confirmed by any source found. Use: the map shows this as institutional, but no source read names a UCSF or university occupant. The permit describes the building as 'research and development' with a proposed use of 'clinics-medic/dental', and the 2025 Assessor roll lists it as a commercial office, 'Medical- dental Office Building'. The CFAR page cited is only an event-location tag and does not show that CFAR is based here.
